title: WCLI-21 4a-2a follow-up: Linux evidence for the replacement test
description: The replacement step in test/qualify-linux-rows.test.ts (the "a new file, a changed file, a mode change, a deletion and a replacement each change it" test) was red on the Linux runner at 818350d and green at 4c3c90e after ctime was added. The ctime is judged load-bearing but only CI shows it; the Mac cannot (a replaced file gets a new inode there). Waits for plan approval; not started.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Whether the inode was reused by the delete-and-rewrite on Linux is recorded
Before the replacement the test polls until a new ctime would exceed the pinned one, with no sleep
Mutant M28 (ctime dropped alone) is run once on the arm runner and its result recorded beside the register; the jetson only under a separate brief
